mentions.name: Post Haste
mentions.description: A free project management tool for creating new projects from templates, letting users define the initial folder structure and project settings while enforcing naming conventions. The new version is a complete redesign from scratch that merges the previously separate Mac and Windows codebases into a single codebase built with Dioxus.
mentions.problem: The current Mac and Windows versions are maintained as two completely separate codebases.
mentions.audience: Video editors, though usable in any industry.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a brand-new version of my free project management tool, Post Haste. It’s a tool for creating new projects from templates where you set the initial folder structure and project settings, as well as enforcing naming conventions. It was initially created for video editors but you can use it in any industry.
